flag_u_1x2.name: Метка «ненадёжный прогноз» Main: разброс 1X2 (бутстреп)
flag_u_1x2.prior: low: found on 2026/27 (already looked at); NOT supported on the selection seasons
flag_u_1x2.ensemble: u_1x2 = mean over H, D, A of the standard deviation over the 8 'boot' members of experiments/v6_2/uncertainty/ensemble.py (production 1X2 model refitted on a bootstrap resample of all matches of seasons < 2026, seeds as in that file)
flag_u_1x2.rule: a Main is flagged when u_1x2 > frozen_threshold (the 0.8 quantile of u_1x2 over the settled Mains of 2026/27 up to this file); the pick and its probability are unchanged
flag_u_1x2.forward_criterion: on the shown Mains of matches played after this file was committed (status WON / LOST): (1) logistic regression won ~ logit(pc) + (u - frozen_mean) / frozen_sd, 95 % bootstrap CI of beta_u (by match, 2000, seed 20261109) entirely below 0; (2) gap(flagged) - gap(not flagged) > 0 with its 95 % CI above 0; evaluated once at >= 2000 settled Mains (or at the end of 2026/27: inconclusive unless both hold)
flag_u_1x2.decision: A (display only: a 'less reliable' label) if (1) and (2) hold; otherwise C

multiplicity: Holm over the hypotheses of this file
shadow: registered as uncertainty_flag_u_1x2 in src/research/registry.py, not implemented yet: it needs the 8 bootstrap 1X2 models stored once (fitted on seasons < 2026); the daily cost is then 8 predictions per match
